description: Get ready-to-paste code for one icon: install command, import, JSX/Vue/Svelte usage, or raw SVG. Unknown names return the closest matches instead of a guess.

name.description: Icon name from search_icons, e.g. "trash" or "chevron-left".

rtl.description: Set true for right-to-left layouts (Arabic, Hebrew). Directional icons such as arrows and chevrons are mirrored; others are unchanged.

size.description: Rendered size in px. Default 24. Stroke weight adapts automatically (16px → 2.25, 20px → 1.8, 24px → 1.5).

strokeWidth.description: Override the stroke weight on the 24px grid. Usually leave unset.

name: get_icon
title: Get icon code
